# Arizona Legislature

> > Official portal for the Arizona Legislature, providing access to bills, legislative sessions, House and Senate records, and government proceedings.

This site serves as the primary digital gateway for Arizona's state legislative branch, offering real-time bill tracking, video archives of legislative sessions, and comprehensive information about the Arizona House of Representatives and Senate activities.

## Key Topics

- Arizona Legislature
- Arizona House of Representatives
- Legislative sessions
- Bill tracking
- Introduced bills
- Government legislation
- Session archives
- Video player
- Government records
- House lists
- Government portal
- Legislative proceedings

## Legislative Core

- [Arizona Legislature](https://www.azleg.gov): Arizona Legislature homepage and government portal
- [Introduced Bills](https://www.azleg.gov/bills): Bill tracking and introduced legislation for Arizona Legislature
- [Video Player](https://www.azleg.gov/videoplayer): Arizona Legislature video player for legislative sessions and archives

## Legislative Records & Lists

- [House Lists](https://www.azleg.gov/house-lists): Arizona House of Representatives lists and records

## Optional

- [Location](https://www.azleg.gov/location): Location information for Arizona Legislature facilities
